THE GAME

WAR ZONE
A gritty first-person shooter in a bombed-out city. Two teams of 10 fight for control while missiles streak overhead and fires burn.
YOUR TEAM
You fight on the BLUE side with 10 bot allies against 10 RED bots. First team to 50 kills wins.
BOTS THAT THINK
Bots plan routes around walls, flank, take cover, share what they see, limp when hurt. Order your allies from the command center.

MAPS

INDUSTRIAL DISTRICT
Warehouses, ruins, a hangar, a watch tower and a container yard.
DESERT OUTPOST
Open dusty ground, a central fort, mud-brick compounds and towers.
CITY BLOCK
Tight streets, tall buildings, alleys and wrecked vehicles.

ARSENAL

ASSAULT RIFLE

Automatic, steady, all-round.
PISTOL

Fast to draw, light recoil.
SNIPER RIFLE

One-shot power with a scope. Unlock in the shop.
SHOTGUN

Devastating up close. Unlock in the shop.

SHOP AND UPGRADES

COINS
10 per kill and 100 per win, plus bonus points from pads and crates.
SOLDIER LOOKS AND CAMOS
Six soldier uniforms and five gun finishes. Your helmet shows your team colour.
UPGRADES AND ITEMS
Armor, damage, quick hands and speed up to level 5, plus frag grenades and smoke bombs.

HOW TO WIN

1. MOVE SMART
Use cover, speed pads and jump pads. Watch the minimap radar.
2. STAY SUPPLIED
Green crates refill your ammo. Health pads heal you.
3. LEAD THE SQUAD
Press / to open the command center and give orders.
5. MISSIONS
Play Campaign, Special Ops, Extraction or Wave Survival to earn XP, level up and unlock new weapons.
4. PRACTICE
Use SHOOTING RANGE on the home page to try every weapon and item for free.
